name: TESSERA BioSeal Class-1 Cleanroom Coverall
description: Crisp ISO-white with subtle grey TESSERA grid-logo repeating across the chest and sleeves, the BioSeal Class-1 is the standard-issue cleanroom suit for chip fabrication and geneware lab environments. The material is ultra-low-particulate spunbonded polyolefin with antistatic thread woven throughout — it crinkles faintly with every movement. All seams are ultrasonically bonded, zero stitching. The integrated hood has a clear polycarbonate face shield with anti-fog coating and a sealed HEPA-filtered breath vent at the chin. Elasticated cuffs mate to sterile gloves. The silhouette is deliberately featureless.
functionality: ISO Class 3 rated — suitable for advanced chip fab and geneware clinic prep zones. Antistatic weave prevents electrostatic discharge near sensitive components. Full-body contamination barrier for both inbound particulates and outbound biological material. Single-use rated; TESSERA officially discourages reuse, though Tier-3 labs regularly re-sterilize.
what_it_says: You work in precision environments where the product is worth more than you are, and the suit makes sure the room never knows you were there.
story_hooks: A TESSERA BioSeal recovered from a black-market geneware clinic still has trace DNA from an unlicensed splice procedure — evidence someone would kill to suppress.
Cleanroom suits are used as anonymous disguises by corporate espionage operatives; inside a fab floor, everyone looks identical.
A technician has been secretly marking their suit with a single microdot of colored pigment each shift — a record of 200 days of unpaid overtime they're building a case around.

physical_description.visual_profile: A pristine, clinical full-body coverall that renders the wearer as an anonymous, sterile form. The silhouette is deliberately shapeless and featureless—designed to contain, not flatter. The integrated hood with clear polycarbonate face shield creates an imposing, almost dehumanized appearance. White dominates, broken only by subtle grey grid logos repeating across the chest and sleeves. The overall impression is institutional, hyper-clean, and vaguely ominous.
physical_description.fit: Loose, roomy, and intentionally non-form-fitting to prevent particulate contact with skin. Elasticated cuffs at wrists and ankles create sealed compression points. The torso and limbs hang in smooth, unflattering planes.
physical_description.primary_material: Ultra-low-particulate spunbonded polyolefin with antistatic thread woven throughout. Non-breathable by design, engineered for isolation rather than comfort.
physical_description.texture: Crisp and papery with a subtle crinkle that audibly accompanies movement. Smooth surface with no pile or nap. Ultrasonically bonded seams create barely-visible ridges; zero traditional stitching visible. The integrated hood's clear polycarbonate face shield has a faint anti-fog coating sheen.
physical_description.color_scheme: Sterile ISO white as primary. Subtle grey repeating TESSERA grid-logo pattern across chest and sleeves. Face shield is transparent polycarbonate with slight blue tint from anti-fog coating.
physical_description.closures: Full-length front zip with sealed guard flap (not visible in catalog pose). Elasticated cuffs at wrists and ankles that mate to sterile gloves and booties. Friction-fit hood seal at neckline.
distinctive_features: Integrated hood with clear polycarbonate anti-fog face shield
HEPA-filtered breath vent at chin with audible micro-fan
Elasticated cuff compression points designed for sterile glove integration
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 1-2 corporate—expensive, restricted-access gear. Only authorized personnel in high-security geneware and chip-fab environments wear this.
physical_description.cultural_context: The wearer is a TESSERA employee, scientist, or technician operating in hyper-sterile environments. Wearing this signals compliance, institutional authority, and access to proprietary fabrication processes. It erases individual identity in favor of corporate uniformity.
physical_description.condition_typical: Always pristine. These are single-use or heavily laundered between cycles. Any visible wear, staining, or degradation indicates protocol failure. A worn TESSERA coverall is a liability.
